frame: three.js world = BIM metres, Y up

exposure.toneMapping: ACESFilmic (three r160: colour *= exposure / 0.6, then ACES)

crop.rule: a triangle is kept when its centre is inside

uv_rule: per triangle, by its face normal n: |n.y| largest -> (x/s, z/s); else |n.x| > |n.z| -> (z/s, y/s); else (x/s, y/s); s = material size_m; the texture repeat is applied on top
